lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Quarter-hour report on Steel/Panther efforts! - Units have been repelled from critical sites. Losses are minimal with recovery predictions at 94% - Current state of Steel: In retreat - Next predicted action: Unknown

lines.speaker: General, Helio
lines.text: Understood. Continue high-profile monitoring, assume next action to occur within seconds. Commander: report on ground units progress against physical Steel sites.

lines.speaker: Commander, Onyx
lines.text: Panther has shutdown 2 physical network sites, but efforts to hack and regain control have failed. Jammers have proven ineffective as air-wave communications have been migrating frequencies at inhuman speeds.

lines.speaker: Commander, Onyx
lines.text: We'll continue to apply pressure on the ground. Requesting permission for air strikes and armored vehicles to assault remaining Steel sites.

lines.speaker: General, Helio
lines.text: Denied. Heavy movement could give away our intent - we can't afford to hand out any more freebies. Moving forward we should assume all communications are compromised... Which I'd like to use to our advantage.

lines.speaker: Commander, Onyx
lines.text: What do you have in mind, sir?

lines.speaker: General, Helio
lines.text: Focus Panther efforts on Steel's armament construction site #14. Humanity depends on those factories, we should defend them at all costs!

lines.speaker: Commander, Onyx
lines.text: *(What in the world...)* Uh, understood General. Redirecting Panther forces to-

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Urgent report on Steel, sir! Forces are rapidly converging towards several armament sites! Nearly all armament sites appear to be targeted!

lines.speaker: General, Helio
lines.text: *(As expected, but...)* Nearly? Give me specifics - which sites?

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Collecting results... All sites except #14 are being targeted, sir!

lines.speaker: General, Helio
lines.text: *(This can't be... it's learning deception?!)* Damn! Commander, build a unified combat force surrounding Panther to support physical site shutdown. We need it offline before it takes over the rest of our physical resources.

lines.speaker: General, Helio
lines.text: I'm granting advanced permissions for additional military forces - including air strikes and- *(No... wait!)*

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Update on Steel! Coordinated anti-air measures are being taken! Airborne forces are being fired on, all allied flight units are retreating!
